state_variables.rebalance_cycle_cost_quote: current conservative remove+add cost; include inventory conversion cost when required
state_variables.fee_reserve_quote: authenticated LP fees attributable to this position since the last mint/resize

hold_rule.condition: A is inside [L,U] and neither compound_resize nor risk_exit is true

compound_resize.purpose: harvest/compound a productive in-range position without converting it into a narrow partial shift
preconditions: a replacement range satisfying all replacement_geometry rules exists
compound_resize.note: Do not churn merely because price moved while still in range; in-range burn/remint requires an economic fee reserve.

geometric_recenter.trigger: first finalized state where A < L or A > U

stale_overrun_cutoff.condition: D > 3.0 before a valid replacement is ready
stale_overrun_cutoff.evidence: fee-driven profitable recenter observations were at or below approximately D=2.79; the major failed reset was observed at D=5.51

replacement_geometry.selection: among executable candidates passing cost stress, choose the candidate with highest expected after-cost fee return; ties choose the narrower width
replacement_geometry.one_sided_replacement: not authorized in v1; observed profitable exceptions require separate inventory-specific validation

execution_timing.on_deadline_miss: discard stale replacement, reread finalized state, and rerun the complete decision
execution_timing.evidence: wide replacements completed within 210 seconds were 9/9 profitable across 7 owners and 8 pools

sizing.source: range-local executable liquidity, not total TVL
sizing.rule: new size <= min(governed target size, largest size with complete executable unwind)

exit_instead_of_remint: authenticated state becomes incomplete or stale
inventory conversion required for a two-sided replacement is uneconomic

promotion_boundary.next_required_step: targeted exact replay / paper validation of this frozen rebalance rule before any holdout access or live strategy promotion
